title: [6.x] Avoid searching server results with fuzzysort

target.summary: Content search results populate the html property using raw item.text (via fuzzysort.single() or the fallback) without HTML escaping. If search results contain HTML markup, it will be rendered unescaped in the command palette, creating an XSS vulnerability.

definition of the computed property whose results contain unescaped html
